NVDA.rationale: Nvidia exhibits exceptional fundamental health: Q3 FY2026 revenue of $57B with 22% QoQ growth, 52% net margins, 70% gross margins, 87% ROE, and a fortress balance sheet ($119B equity vs $8.5B debt). Operating cash flow of $23.75B in the latest quarter demonstrates massive cash generation. The company dominates AI accelerators with ~90% market share and benefits from $700B+ in hyperscaler capex commitments. However, the stock trades at 66.8x trailing P/E — the top of its 12-month range (43-67) — and 57.8x P/B, also at the high end. This rich valuation partially offsets the outstanding fundamentals. The near-term catalyst of Q1 FY2027 earnings on May 20 (consensus $78.8B revenue, 77% YoY growth) with 90% prediction-market probability of a beat provides a modest positive modifier, though the stock has already rallied 26% in the past quarter, potentially pricing in much of the good news. Key risks include China market share at zero due to export controls, growing custom chip competition from hyperscalers (Amazon Trainium, Google TPU), and the Culper Research short report alleging undisclosed China exposure. The combination of world-class fundamentals and trajectory but elevated valuation warrants a moderately positive score.
